Questions

What does “Online calculators and quote builders” cost?
The MVP costs $1,000–3,000 (UZS 12–36.5 mln), the full version $3,500–8,000 (UZS 42–97 mln). The exact price depends on the integrations and the scope.
How long does “Online calculators and quote builders” take?
The MVP takes 1–3 weeks, the full version 3–6 weeks.
What do we need to provide?
Domain and hosting access; texts, photos and the logo; one person who makes the decisions.
